paper_metadata.title: Microstructural, Oxidation, and Mechanical Behavior of NbTi-Based Refractory Alloys with 5 to 10 Pct Co, Cr, and Ni Additions

evidence.quote: NbTi-based refractory alloys with additions of Co, Cr, and Ni represent an interesting medium-entropy alloy system

Additions of 5 at. pct Co, 10 at. pct Ni, and CoCrNi can be made to the NbTi system to produce single-phase BCC solid solutions approaching the lower bound of the medium-entropy alloy range (near 1.0 R).
